02891c790c2566ca.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

Job Title: Analyst – Pricing Operations
Location: Bangalore
Team: Finance Operations
Job Type: Full-time

Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and process-driven Analyst – Pricing Operations to join our Financial Operations team. In this role, you will play a critical part in reviewing and executing pricing revamp requests for our merchants, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency across multiple payment methods. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage workflows, validate profitability, and help maintain a high standard of operational excellence. If you thrive in a fast-paced fintech environment and enjoy working with structured processes, we would love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
● Validate Pricing Requests: Review and verify all incoming pricing revamp requests from the POC team to ensure proper approvals, accuracy, and completeness.
● Configure Pricing Plans: Set up and modify merchant pricing across various payment methods (e.g., Cards, UPI Recurring, E-Mandate, Optimiser) in line with defined SOPs.
● Coordinate with Stakeholders: Raise tickets with the Banking Operations team to validate margins and with the Checker team for final approvals.
● Workflow Management: Initiate and track pricing revamp workflows through to closure, ensuring timely execution and proper documentation of all approvals.
● Policy Compliance: Ensure all pricing changes comply with internal policies, including securing Function Head approvals where pricing may impact profitability.

Qualifications & Requirements
● 0.6–2 years of experience in an operations, pricing, or reconciliation role—preferably in the fintech or payments sector.
● Strong understanding of process governance and attention to detail in executing SOP- based tasks.
● Experience using ticketing systems such as Salesforce, Freshdesk, or similar tools.
● Excellent communication skills for effective coordination with internal teams.
● Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
● Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently as well as in cross- functional settings.

Why Join Us?
● Opportunity to work in a high-growth fintech environment.
● Exposure to cross-functional teams and hands-on execution of pricing strategy operations.
● A culture that values ownership, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
 
Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

Headquarters: Remote, US

** Open to remote within the East Coast only**

At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. This is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit and just all-around great people. Here, if you’re willing to do more, your career can take off. And since software plays a central role in everyone’s lives, you’ll be part of an important mission. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

As a Solution Engineer, Public Sector at JFrog, you will be on the front lines as a trusted technical advisor, helping federal, state, and local government clients understand, evaluate, and adopt our solutions. You will work closely with our sales, product & engineering, customer success, and marketing teams to help customers understand the value of JFrog solutions from a technical and business perspective.

As a Solution Engineer, Public Sector in JFrog, you will...

• Partner with Account Executives to align technical solutions with customer goals, support presales engagements, and drive revenue through strategic value selling.

• Understand and navigate public sector requirements, including procurement processes, NIST guidelines, DoD frameworks (e.g., PlatformOne, IronBank), and federal compliance mandates (e.g., CMMC).

• Deliver impactful demos and Proof of Value (POVs) to technical and non-technical stakeholders, showcasing how JFrog enables secure, scalable DevSecOps and MLOps practices.

• Support RFIs/RFPs and bid processes, ensuring technical accuracy and alignment with government procurement standards.

• Guide customers throughout the technical lifecycle, translating business goals into solution designs and collaborating with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap based on field feedback.

• Evangelize DevSecOps best practices, including the development of DoD/Federal reference architectures, and drive adoption across federal agencies.

• Stay current with industry trends, maintaining expertise in DevOps, cloud, software delivery, and emerging technologies relevant to public sector digital transformation.

To be a Solution Engineer, Public Sector in JFrog, you need...

• 5+ years of hands-on expertise in DevOps technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD tools, Artifactory, build tools, and modern SDLC practices.

• 3+ years hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning (SCA, SAST, DAST), network security, container/Kubernetes security, software supply chain security (SBOMs, artifact signing, SLSA), and embedding security into CI/CD pipelines.

• Technical sales, presales, or sales engineering experience is a plus, preferably with U.S. public sector clients; experience with MEDDPICC methodology is a plus.

• Knowledge of public sector programs and compliance, including DoD environments, impact level classifications, NIST standards, and federal procurement models.

• Proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux environments, with ability to design hybrid architectures and scalable deployment solutions.

• Proven ability to deliver POCs and technical presentations, with strong communication skills to articulate business value to both technical and executive audiences.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Customer-centric, solution-oriented mindset and a strong passion for enabling mission success.

• U.S. Citizenship is required for this role.

• Travel required - Ability to travel at least 25% throughout the U.S., meeting with clients and supporting field engagement activities across agencies and events.

• Government security requirements may be needed; active security clearance a plus.

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

• This role has a preference for applicants based in Washington D.C.

• At JFrog, base salary is only one component of our compensation package.

• This position has a base salary range between $160,000 to $172,500. 

• Base salary will be based on your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

• Additionally, this role is eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments.

• This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU). 

• In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.JFrog provides employees comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, retirement, wellness and much more!

JFrog is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status or any other category protected by law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jfrog-solution-engineer-presales-public-sector-us-remote

02fdb5ecb669d228.description: About the Company: Ruder Finn is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Data Analyst III) to join its award-winning Emerging Technology & Analytics team. Job Responsibilities: - Collaborate with the global Emerging Technology & Analytics team colleagues in research projects pertaining to new business or client mandates involving sourcing, analysis, and reporting of data and insights tied to the concerned business objectives - Deliver market and audience intelligence, including social and digital landscape analysis, audience behavior analysis, sentiment analysis, keyword research, search performance, and competitor analysis including but not limited to share of voice and message pull through - Build measurement frameworks, set up searches and dashboards using Boolean queries, and develop client-facing insights and reports Qualifications: - Bachelor's Degree in business analytics, computer science, marketing, psychology, or advertising preferred - A minimum of 4 years of agency or in-house experience in a data or research analyst role - Experience and expertise with writing complex Boolean queries and operating data and media analytics tools such as Cision, Brandwatch, Rival IQ, Meltwater, Signal AI, etc. - Expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics and one or more contemporary data visualization platforms (e.g.: Tableau, Power BI, Google Data Studio, etc.) along with SQL - Proficiency in AWS, Python, R, and any other statistical computing or functional programming language is a major plus - Experience with data modeling and developing custom models is a plus - Experience with custom LLMs and working with the contemporary LLMs (e.g. ChatGPT, Bard, etc.) is a plus - Excellent problem-solving, creative thinking, general modeling, and data processing skills - Strong project management skills, self-starter, ability to adapt and multi-task, and a proven track record of delivering quality and accurate results in a quick-paced and high efficiency agency environment - Extremely strong verbal and written English language communication skills .

028c3e7fa7f8c19b.description: About Xeliport Xeliport is building the AI-native operating system for cross-border expansion. We help consumer brands launch and scale in new countries by bringing incorporation, compliance, logistics, warehousing, payments, and marketplace operations into a single platform. We're an early-stage startup building from zero, and product here isn't a support function, it's core to whether Xeliport works at all. The Opportunity We're hiring our first dedicated Technical Product Manager. This is a founding-team role in every practical sense: you'll work directly with the founders and our founding engineer to decide what gets built next and why, across our six operational layers (Compliance, Shipping, 3PL & Warehouse, Marketplace, Retail & B2B, Forex & Banking). We're looking for someone junior in years but not in ambition: hungry to learn the entire business fast, and genuinely aiming to run product at Xeliport one day. If you do this well, there's a real path from this seat to Head of Product to CPO as we scale, not a hypothetical one. We also want our product and engineering craft to be as tight and considered as the best in the world runs theirs, think Shopify's bar for product quality and internal tooling, not "startup MVP good enough." You'll be one of the people who sets that bar. What You'll Do - Own specs end-to-end: talk to operators, brands, and the founders to figure out what actually needs to get built, then write it down clearly enough that engineering can just build it. - Prioritize ruthlessly across Compliance, Shipping, 3PL & Warehouse, Marketplace, Retail & B2B, and Forex & Banking, we have far more to build than time to build it. - Get into the data. Query our database directly, read the schema, understand what's actually happening in production before making a call. - Sit close enough to engineering to review PRs, understand architecture tradeoffs, and push back on shortcuts that hurt product quality. - Talk to real operators and brands to find out what's broken before it shows up as a support ticket. - Build the muscle to eventually own the roadmap and product strategy outright. What We're Looking For - 0-2 years of experience, early in your career, but you've shipped something (a product, a side project, a feature) that shows you think in systems, not just tasks. - Technical enough to read code and a data model and have real opinions about them. You don't need to ship production code, but you should be comfortable in a codebase. - Obsessed with product craft: you can point to a product whose quality you admire and explain exactly why it works. - Hungry and ambitious: you're looking for a launchpad to run product, not a two-year resume line. - Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, we're writing it as we go. Nice to Have - Exposure to Next.js, Supabase, or Sanity, or the willingness to get hands-on with our stack fast. - Experience with, or obsessive interest in, high-craft consumer or B2B SaaS products (Shopify-caliber design and engineering bar). - Some understanding of cross-border trade, logistics, or compliance. We can teach this, but curiosity about it is a plus. What We Offer Direct access to the founders, real ownership over product decisions from day one, meaningful ESOPs, and a genuine track to CPO if you earn it. How to Apply To apply, fill out this form: https://forms.gle/BZ8stuGRYKgRe3E96

0202bda1beaa5ce3.description: Job TitleSenior Global Product Manager (Respiratory Therapy) Job DescriptionSenior Global Product Manager (Respiratory Therapy) In this role, you will lead partnership strategy and legacy portfolio lifecycle management within the Respiratory Therapies segment. You will drive the commercial success of products brought to market through strategic partnerships owning go-to-market planning, business case development, and launch performance while also ensuring the legacy portfolio continues to meet customer needs through service excellence and smart portfolio optimization. Launch Execution & Performance Management: Support regional teams in executing local launch plans and own the performance management cadence post-launch tracking adoption, identifying gaps, and driving corrective actions to deliver on committed targets.
